ImageDescription.value: Improving how we dispose of refrigerant chemicals is one of the most important solutions to climate change. Coolants commonly used in refrigerators and air conditioners, called hydrofluorocarbons or HFCs, trap heat in the atmosphere 1,000 to 9,000 times better than carbon dioxide. Avoiding leaks, switching to alternatives, and properly disposing of old refrigerants is one of the single biggest solutions to climate change. An old refrigerator with its doors open sits outside with trees and a mountain in the background.
